description:
Tick is a local-first market watchlist that lives in your menu bar: see how the symbols you care about are doing without opening a trading terminal.

MENU BAR TICKER
Discreet icon mode by default; pin a single symbol to the menu bar (NVDA 188.3 +2.1%) or rotate through your watchlist as a carousel.

WATCHLISTS
US stocks, Hong Kong stocks, China A-shares, Japanese and Korean stocks, cryptocurrencies, precious metals, indices, and ETFs. Organize symbols into named groups, pin favorites, and reorder with native drag and drop.

POSITIONS & TRADE LOG
Track quantity and cost basis with automatic market value, daily P&L, and total P&L. Recorded trades can be edited or deleted.

DETAILS & CHARTS
Intraday lines and daily / weekly / monthly candlesticks with volume, plus price, change, OHLC, amplitude, realtime / delayed status, and source attribution in a dense layout.

MULTI-PROVIDER ROUTING
Each market routes to the best available data source (Eastmoney, Tencent, Sina, Yahoo, Naver, Binance and more) with automatic caching and failover. Providers poll only while their markets are open, each at its own cadence.

REAL-TIME CRYPTO
Binance Spot public market data: symbol search, quotes, and charts, with 1-second WebSocket ticker updates while the popover is open.

PRECIOUS METALS
London spot gold and silver, COMEX / NYMEX contracts, SGE Au99.99, and SHFE gold and silver futures. Searching "gold" lists all three golds.

LONGBRIDGE REAL-TIME (OPTIONAL)
Connect your own Longbridge account (browser authorization or API keys) to upgrade HK / US / A-share quotes to official real-time data, including the US overnight session. Credentials stay in your Keychain.

SHARE CARDS
Copy a mobile-friendly branded snapshot image, or export a structured market snapshot with source, timestamp, session, and chart data for analysis in an LLM.

LOCAL MCP (OPTIONAL, OFF BY DEFAULT)
A built-in Model Context Protocol server binds to loopback only with a Keychain-stored bearer token, letting Claude, ChatGPT, and other MCP clients read and edit your watchlists and positions.

PRIVACY
No personal data collection, no built-in analytics. Watchlists and credentials stay on your device. See the privacy policy for details.

Tick is built on the open-source Pulse project (MIT license).
promotionalText: Glanceable market data for the symbols you care about.
whatsNew: First App Store release: menu bar ticker, watchlists, positions and P&L, candlestick charts, crypto and precious metals quotes, optional Longbridge real-time data and local MCP.
